componentAcceptance: All T16 criteria are covered. Invalid, missing or revoked credentials fail before tool admission without an operation row. Public read models, diagnostics and SQLite contain no pairing token, and host-only secret UI prevents Bot sharing. A real leak in resolveSecret error propagation is fixed: private resolver exceptions are normalized to MACHINE_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE for both grant issue and remote revoke. The new regression uses an exception containing endpoint and token and confirms no tool action, no operation and no token in the error, public projection or database. Related suites pass 36/36.
productAcceptance: T16 passes at integration level. Credentials fail closed before action and secret text is not exposed through model-facing errors, logs or diagnostics. Formal scores are 0/20 work packages, 9/63 scenarios and M0 11/12.
implementation: A single secretFor helper validates the existing DS secret service result and converts any resolver exception to the same public code without preserving the private cause text.
Grant issuance and remote revocation both use this helper; no endpoint or token is added to the public error.
Existing 401/AUTH_INVALID, bounded audit redaction, digest-only storage and host-only namespace guards are unchanged.
testRuns: remote-machines + remote-auth + machine-secrets + remote-write: 36 tests / 36 pass / 0 fail.
Final npm test: phase one 1590/1586/0/4 and phase two 371/288/0/83; total 1961 tests, 1876 pass, 0 fail, 83 skipped.
preservedFailures: Code review confirmed that a resolver exception containing endpoint/token previously escaped unchanged through issue/revoke. The new regression now proves that path is uniformly redacted.
limitations: This closes the credential failure/redaction scenario, not protected production network deployment or every credential backend.
No real model inference, production process, push or release was used.
